courses.title: Intensive Persian for Heritage Speakers
courses.description: Designed for heritage speakers with prior exposure to Persian speaking and listening. courses.subject: PRS
courses.title: Persian across Disciplines
courses.description: Students read and discuss Persian language materials related to the subject matter of another designated course. One lecture hour a week for one semester. No more than three semester hours may be counted toward the major in either Middle Eastern Studies or Middle Eastern Languages and Culture. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Upper-division standing, Persian 322L, and consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Upper-division standing, Persian 322L, and consent of instructor.

courses.subject: PRS
courses.title: Conference Course in Persian Language and Literature
courses.description: Supervised individual study of selected problems in Persian language or literature. Conference course. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Nine semester hours of upper-division coursework in Persian and consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Nine semester hours of upper-division coursework in Persian and consent of instructor.

courses.subject: PRS
courses.title: Topics in Persian Language
courses.description: Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Graduate standing, and six semester hours of upper-division coursework in Persian or consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing, and six semester hours of upper-division coursework in Persian or consent of instructor.

courses.subject: PRS
courses.title: Intensive Graduate Language Instruction I
courses.description: Intensive cultural and literacy-focused training in Persian at the beginning level in preparation for research with Persian sources. Includes an independent project component. Incoming students are placed in the appropriate level by means of a departmental placement test. Six lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing.

courses.subject: PRS
courses.title: Intensive Graduate Language Instruction II
courses.description: Intensive cultural and literacy-focused training in Persian at the low-intermediate level in preparation for research with Persian sources. Incoming students are placed in the appropriate level by means of a departmental placement test. Six lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Graduate standing and Persian 381H with a grade of at least B.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing and Persian 381H with a grade of at least B.

courses.subject: PRS
courses.title: Intermediate Graduate Language Instruction I
courses.description: Intensive cultural and literacy-focused training in Persian at the intermediate level in preparation for research with Persian sources. Includes an independent project component. Incoming students are placed in the appropriate level by means of a departmental placement test. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Graduate standing and Persian 381J with a grade of at least B.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing and Persian 381J with a grade of at least B.

courses.subject: PRS
courses.title: Intermediate Graduate Language Instruction II
courses.description: Intensive cultural and literacy-focused training in Persian at the high-intermediate level in preparation for research with Persian sources. Includes an independent project component. Incoming students are placed in the appropriate level by means of a departmental placement test. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Graduate standing and Persian 381K with a grade of at least B.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing and Persian 381K with a grade of at least B.

courses.subject: PRS
courses.title: Topics in Persian Linguistics and Philology
courses.description: Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in Persian studies.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing in Persian studies.

courses.subject: PRS
courses.title: Topics in Persian Literature
courses.description: Study of various aspects and periods of Persian language and literature. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Graduate standing, three semester hours of upper-division coursework in Persian, and consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing, three semester hours of upper-division coursework in Persian, and consent of instructor.

courses.subject: PRS
courses.title: Conference Course in Persian Studies
courses.description: Supervised individual study of selected problems in Persian studies. The equivalent of three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Graduate standing, consent of the graduate adviser, and consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing, consent of the graduate adviser, and consent of instructor.
